content: 1. I have used the title Associate Editor(s)-In-Chief only once on a page. 2. I have included all possible synonyms for a symptom or disease. These synonyms can be found in the Disease database, which is located in the Infobox of the disease on the top right side. 3. I have created redirects to the page for all the synonyms. 4. I have removed links to eMedicine in the navigation box, as we do not promote traffic to eMedicine, which is a competitor. 5. I have checked whether there is a patient information page for the disease or symptom. 6. I have followed the order shown in the Template to Add a New Disease when editing the page. 7. I have used the exact titles for the subheadings as shown in the Template to Add a New Disease. 8. I have ensured that there are no bullet lists in the overview statement. The overview should be written as text, not as bullet points, because Google uses the overview statements to form rich snippets in search results. 9. I did not number the causes of a disease. 10. I have used the | symbol to separate links on the homepage of a disease, rather than separating contents with other symbols. 11. I have created redirects to all the causes of a disease. 12. I have ensured that all words are spelled correctly before saving the page. 13. I have ensured there is appropriate spacing between words and sentences. Specifically, there is a single space between words and two spaces between sentences in a paragraph. 14. I have checked that the first word in each subheading is capitalized. 15. I have ensured that the words Common, Causes, Causes by Organ System, and Causes in Alphabetical Order are capitalized. 16. I have checked that I have added and without spaces where appropriate, if it was not already present. 17. I have checked that I have added without spaces on every disease page if it was not already present. 18. I have verified whether the National Library of Medicine has a chapter on the symptom or sign I am working on. 19. I have spelled out abbreviations upon their first use. 20. I have added Risk factors from the Patient information page if I could not find them elsewhere. 21. I have checked for a patient information page and linked it to the WikiDoc page. 22. I have searched for the specific subsection of a page where I need to redirect a link and used the following code format: `HydrocephalusNon-communicating hydrocephalus` to navigate directly to that subsection when clicking the link. 23. I have ensured that I have unified synonym pages without deleting the content and organized the page according to the templates and guidelines (e.g., combining the dyspepsia and indigestion pages). 24. I have ensured that I have not added any links to the Synonyms and keywords section. 25. I have ensured that only the first word in the Synonyms and keywords section is capitalized, unless it is a proper noun like Hodgkin's lymphoma. 26. I have removed the reference template `{{reflist|2}}` and the `{{SI}}` tag from the homepage of the sign or symptom when they are completely micro-chaptered as per the template. 27. Additionally, I have removed the `<ref>` tag from all pages to ensure faster page loading. 28. I have created a user page and linked my name to the pages I have contributed to. 29. I have ensured that I understand the type of information that belongs in each subheading. For example, risk factors for a disease are distinct from its causes, and I would not simply restate the causes of the disease as risk factors. 30. I have ensured that there is no extra space between subheadings. 31. I have ensured that tables end with the `|}` command at the bottom. 32. I have removed external links unless they are to legitimate government sites or high-quality patient sites. 33. I have ensured that synonyms are not included in the == Overview == statement.
